task_objective: Add an exact-release audit entry point, durable per-release verdict persistence, and the classification adapter required by catalog gating; then address round-01 review findings.
design_decisions: Kept _record_verdict as the sole enforcement point for rejecting AUDIT_ERROR persistence so every current and future caller gets the invariant.
Made the completed audit path call _record_verdict unconditionally while retaining the separate non-error condition only for cached report writes.
Pinned the persistence invariant through a completed audit with a required Trivy scanner status of failed, avoiding the unrelated early return from download failures.
